steps.title: Implement basic arithmetic functions
steps.description: Create functions for basic arithmetic operations: add, subtract, multiply, and divide. Each function should take two numbers and return the result.
hints: Handle division by zero in the divide function

verification.failureMessage: Implement add, subtract, multiply, and divide.

steps.title: Create a calculate function
steps.description: Write a calculate function that takes two numbers and an operator string (+, -, *, /) and returns the result by calling the appropriate arithmetic function.
hints: Use a switch or if/else statement on the operator
Call the appropriate function based on the operator
Return an error message for unsupported operators

steps.title: Parse and evaluate expressions
steps.description: Write a function that parses a simple arithmetic expression string like "5 + 3" and evaluates it. Split the string by spaces to get the operands and operator.
hints: Parse the first and third parts as numbers
Call calculate with the parsed values

steps.title: Add memory and history features
steps.description: Extend the calculator with memory functions (M+, M-, MC, MR) and a history log that stores past calculations.
hints: Use a variable to store the memory value
Keep an array or list for history

verification.failureMessage: Implement memory store, recall, clear, and calculation history.

steps.title: Create an interactive REPL
steps.description: Build a simple REPL (Read-Eval-Print Loop) that accepts expressions from the user, evaluates them, and displays the result until the user types "quit" or "exit".
hints: Use a loop that reads input and evaluates expressions
Display "Welcome to the Calculator!" on startup
Show the result after each calculation

verification.failureMessage: Create a loop that reads, evaluates, and prints results.
